Chairperson’s Message
It is with great pleasure that I welcome you to the
Department of Human Resource and Information Management (HRIM), IBL, Abdul Wali Khan University, Mardan.
In today’s advanced human resource (HR) ecosystem, the integration of HR and technology enabled insights is not an option, but a vital tool of next-generation leaders. The HRIM department is at the forefront of this digital transformation, enabling students to become professionals who not only focus the people part but also make use of organizational data for strategic decisions. We believe that the future of work emphasizes on the balance of workforce and technologies, and that’s what we target to teach here.
Our programs are well designed to meet the demands of the market with state-of-the-art knowledge in human resource management, organizational behavior, and related information systems. Currently, the department offers
BBA, BS- Business Analytics, MBA (Business, Non-business, Executive, Supply Chain Management), MS and PhD
in this specialized area.
Our vibrant faculty bring a rich mix of academia-industry exposure help you prepare workforce of the future. With a team of highly qualified faculty members, research, innovation, and continuous learning lie at the heart of our department.
We also feel proud on our growing linkages with industry, public institutions, alumni networks and global research-oriented organizations, which provide students with career opportunities, trainings, industry exposure opportunities, research support, guest lectures, and scholarships.
To prospective students and collaborators, I sincerely invite you to be part of our journey towards innovation, leadership and excellence in human resource and information management field.

Dr. Muhammad Jehangir
Chairman
Department of Human Resource and Information Management
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
